labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for new behaviour (unit styling in ReprHighlighter); feature requests go through Discussions first.

items.body:
Thanks for the suggestion. This is a feature request, and Rich asks that new features be approved in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened. Please start there if you would like to pursue it.

Rich already lets you style units without changing `ReprHighlighter`: subclass `RegexHighlighter` with your own pattern. See [the highlighting docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/highlighting.rst) for an example.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
